title: Hugging Face launches llama.cpp benchmark for Ryzen and Radeon
teaser: Hugging Face has launched an open llama.cpp benchmark for AMD Ryzen processors and Radeon graphics cards. The dashboard shows prompt-processing and text-generation speeds across different llama.cpp builds, models and quantization formats. The data and test scenarios are publicly available: results can be compared across builds, used to examine local inference performance and plotted in custom charts.
